definitions.a: twice the clicks of a slot's four modes over the clicks of modes 0..8, per iteration
definitions.a_prime: (a - a_dark) / (a_anchor - a_dark) with the slot's own anchor and dark
definitions.l_hat: calibrated level: the slot's dark-subtracted clicks over its efficiency relative to the failure mode, in the same ratio; the efficiency is a / (2 - a) of the slot's dark-subtracted anchor level
definitions.pooling: the two slot orientations of one block item average their calibrated levels

interpretation: Conformance of programmed operator blocks to their interference law on one 12-mode mesh with two blocks per photon; the client computes every cd_core sign, so the chip does not compute the algebra.

simulator_gate.scope: sim:ascella is noiseless: the gate checks the client and pipeline, not the device
